Kami menciptakan lingkungan kerja inovatif, inklusif, dan kolaboratif di mana bakat berkembang, ide berkembang, dan memberikan peluang karier dengan rasa syukur dan kebahagiaan. XLSMART bukan hanya tempat kerja yang hebat—ini adalah tempat terbaik untuk berkembang menjadi versi terbaik dari individu yang luar biasa. Jangan pernah mengatakan tidak untuk berkembang bersama XLSMART, bersama kita akan menjalani perjalanan yang penuh hasil—kamu, aku, dan setiap karyawan, bersatu dalam meredefinisikan masa depan Indonesia. jobs.title: Werkstudent:in Influencer- & UGC-Marketing – Purēcha
jobs.description: Werkstudent:in Influencer- & UGC-Marketing (m/w/d) – 15–20 Std./Woche, Kiel Du scrollst sowieso den ganzen Tag durch Reels und weißt, welche Creator wirklich Reichweite haben? Dann bau mit uns den Creator-Kanal für eine Marke auf, die gerade von der Café-Theke in die Küche zieht. Wer wir sind Purēcha ist unsere Latte-Konzentrat-Marke – Matcha, Chai und Ube, flüssig statt Pulver, in zehn Sekunden fertig. Bisher läuft Purēcha in über 1000 Cafés. Jetzt bringen wir es als Latte-Trio direkt zu Endkund:innen, und dafür brauchen wir Creator, die unser Produkt in ihrer Küche zeigen. Hinter Purēcha steht die Pure Beverage GmbH aus Kiel: ein Team von rund 15 Leuten, das Getränke entwickelt und in der eigenen Manufaktur in Neumünster abfüllt. Deine Aufgaben Du bist die Person, die unseren Creator-Kanal von null aufbaut – mit eigener Verantwortung, nicht als Zuarbeit. Creator finden: Du recherchierst Micro-Creator (3–50k Follower) in den Bereichen Matcha, Home-Café, Food und Lifestyle auf Instagram und TikTok und baust eine Pipeline von 100+ passenden Profilen auf. Ansprechen und gewinnen: Du schreibst Creator persönlich an, verhandelst Konditionen im vorgegebenen Rahmen und bringst jeden Monat 15–20 Kooperationen zum Abschluss. Seeding organisieren: Du koordinierst Pakete, Briefings und Deadlines, hältst Creator bei der Stange und sorgst dafür, dass Clips pünktlich und brauchbar ankommen. UGC steuern: Du gibst Creator-Clips Feedback anhand unseres Briefings, sicherst Nutzungsrechte und übergibst fertiges Material an unser Ads-Team. Auswerten: Du trackst in einem Sheet oder CRM, wer wann was geliefert hat, was es gekostet hat und welche Clips in den Ads funktionieren – und leitest daraus ab, welche Creator-Typen wir öfter buchen. Mitdenken: Du bringst eigene Ideen für Formate, Challenges und Kooperationen ein und testest sie. Das bringst du mit Wichtiger als dein Studiengang ist, dass du Social Media nicht nur konsumierst, sondern verstehst, warum etwas funktioniert. Must-haves

jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist - Behavior AI
jobs.description: The Behavior AI team builds the AI-based anomaly detection behind Datadog s security products. Our models learn what normal looks like across the billions of logs, events, and telemetry records flowing through the platform every second, and they flag the behavior that does not fit, on every record, in real time, at a cost that makes sense at our scale. What we build does not ship to a single feature. The same models power detection across many of Datadog s security products at once, so the work has impact well beyond any one team. Large general-purpose models are too slow and too expensive to run in that path, so we take the opposite approach: small, custom models, designed for high-throughput stream processing and optimized to run cheaply on every record.   We are hiring a Senior Applied Scientist to build these models from start to finish. You will contribute to designing the architecture, training at scale, and the optimization work that takes a model from training to running efficiently on production traffic. This optimization requires a deep understanding of the constraints imposed by both the software and the hardware, together with the applied mathematics to work within them: often it comes down to finding a mathematical reformulation that fits those constraints better, and that judgment can decide whether a model reaches production at all.   The work involves a number of open questions. How do you obtain most of the quality of a large model from one that is far smaller and cheap enough to run on the full stream? Where is it worth trading exactness for speed, and how do you reason about the error you accept? How do you make a small model s outputs clear enough that the detection engineers and analysts who rely on it can trust what it reports? If these are the problems you want to work on, we would like to hear from you.   At Datadog, we place value in our office culture: the relationships and collaboration it builds, and the creativity it bring

jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist - AI Platform
jobs.description: AI Platform builds the foundations of Datadog s AI efforts. The org is 70+ people organised in three pillars: training and serving (GPU clusters, distributed training, low-level infrastructure), agents (agent harnesses, memory systems, the internal AI gateway that routes every LLM request at Datadog), and evaluation and experimentation. This role sits in the evaluation and experimentation pillar, which owns Datadog s shared annotation and evaluation infrastructure — including the evaluation scenario store and the telemetry archival systems used across the Bits org. Together they let an agent travel back in time and query what Datadog looked like at the exact moment an incident happened, so scenarios can be replayed and agent performance tracked over time. Specifically, you ll be the first applied scientist on GenSim (Generative Simulations), the team that builds the environments Datadog s agents learn in. GenSim doesn t replay sampled telemetry — it stands up real, fully instrumented applications that talk to Datadog, drives them with representative traffic, injects controlled failures, and records what happens. Because GenSim injected the failure, it knows the ground truth. That corpus — hundreds of postmortem-derived scenarios and thousands of runnable applications — is today the primary source of post-training data for Datadog s own SRE model, and the substrate that Bits AI SRE and our other agents are trained and evaluated against. The team has no applied science support today and is learning post-training data methodology on the fly. That s the gap this role fills, and the open questions are the interesting part. How do you tell whether a generated environment is actually representative of the messy, incomplete telemetry real customers run — rather than a suspiciously clean one where every monitor exists and every service emits complete logs? Du vermittelst Gesundheitsthemen verständlich und sorgfältig, ohne übertriebene Versprech

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: Bau die KI für eine Stadt, die einfach funktioniert. Ein Vorgang bleibt liegen, weil Wissen nur in einzelnen Köpfen steckt. Mitarbeitende suchen Informationen über mehrere Systeme hinweg. Wiederkehrende Aufgaben kosten Zeit, die für die Anliegen der Menschen fehlt. Bei summ ai wollen wir das ändern. Wir bauen KI-gestützte Software für Prozessmanagement und Automatisierung im öffentlichen Sektor. Unser Ziel: Verwaltungswissen zugänglich machen, Abläufe vereinfachen und Routinearbeit automatisieren – mit Software, die Menschen gerne nutzen und die sich mit ihren Anforderungen weiterentwickelt. Dafür arbeiten wir eng mit unseren Kunden zusammen. Wir verstehen ihre Probleme, bringen Lösungen früh in den Einsatz und verbessern sie anhand echter Nutzung. Als AI Engineer gestaltest du diesen Weg mit: von der Produktidee über die technische Umsetzung bis zur Frage, ob die KI im Alltag zuverlässig hilft. Deine Aufgaben Probleme verstehen und Lösungen gestalten: Du sprichst direkt mit Kunden, hinterfragst Anforderungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team Ideen, die du früh mit Nutzern überprüfst. KI-Funktionen und Agenten bauen: Du verantwortest die Umsetzung vom Interface bis zum Backend. Du verbindest Modelle mit Datenquellen und Werkzeugen und gestaltest Prompts, Kontext und Agentenabläufe. KI-Qualität verbessern: Du analysierst Fehler aus der Nutzung, baust Evaluationen auf und vergleichst Modelle hinsichtlich Qualität, Geschwindigkeit und Kosten. Du kannst zeigen, ob eine Änderung tatsächlich besser funktioniert. Bis in den Betrieb Verantwortung übernehmen: Du bringst Funktionen live, beobachtest ihre Nutzung und entwickelst sie weiter. Zu deiner Arbeit gehören auch Deployment, Monitoring und die nötige Cloud-Infrastruktur. Unsere Entwicklung voranbringen: Du nutzt KI-Werkzeuge, automatisierst wiederkehrende Arbeit und hilfst dem Team, schneller zu verlässlichen Ergebnissen zu kommen. Das bringst du mit Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und die Fähigkei

jobs.title: (Senior) SEO & GEO Manager // AI Music Video Platform
jobs.description: Neural Frames is a leading AI music video generator, turning any song into a fully produced music video in minutes. We're bootstrapped, profitable, and generating more than $7M in annualized revenue. Our ambition is to build a category-defining company that helps tens of millions of audio creators visualize and promote their work. Organic search has historically been our most important acquisition channel: product pages, free tools and landing pages in many languages that bring musicians and creators to us every day. It has never had a dedicated owner. At the same time, search is changing faster than at any point in the last decade, and more and more discovery happens inside AI answers on Google, ChatGPT and Perplexity. We're looking for our first Senior SEO & GEO Manager to own organic acquisition end to end: decide what we build and why, make it genuinely useful, get it shipped, and show what it changed in signups and paying customers. jobs.title: Duales Studium (B.Sc.) Wirtschaftsinformatik 2027
jobs.description: Die Projektron GmbH entwickelt und vertreibt die webbasierte Projektmanagement-Software BCS. Für die Unterstützung unserer europaweit über 820 Kunden sowie die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Software sorgen mehr als 130 Mitarbeiter an fünf Standorten in Deutschland. Für das Jahr 2027 suchen wir für unseren Hauptsitz in Berlin duale Studenten für den Studiengang B.Sc. Informatik in Kooperation mit der HWR Berlin. Wir möchten insbesondere Frauen dazu ermutigen, sich bei uns zu bewerben. Aufgaben Im Rahmen deines Studiums erhältst du die Möglichkeit, Praxiserfahrung bei einem der besten Arbeitgeber Berlin Brandenburgs zu sammeln. jobs.title: TUM Project Study: Earned LinkedIn Media for Enterprise
jobs.description: About us Mediacharge GmbH is a Munich-based, internationally oriented marketing agency with ten years of experience in cutting-edge marketing for international enterprises. Operating in 14 languages, we combine first-tier strategic consulting with hands-on operational excellence, measured against business results. Project description (TUM Project) This project study explores what turns an enterprise’s own people into LinkedIn voices that measurably drive Sales, Recruiting or Employer Brand. Using Mediacharge and its enterprise clients as the case environment, it examines how earned media, meaning content published by real people rather than paid brand channels, creates business impact. The project combines a business strategy perspective - objectives, the right people and measurable outcomes - with a content and platform perspective, focusing on talent profiles, content types, success patterns and the time it takes to build an effective voice. Objectives of the project study to classify enterprise objectives for earned LinkedIn media (Sales, Recruiting, Employer Brand), to identify which talent profiles and content types work best for each objective, to derive success patterns, including what it takes and how long it takes to see results, to develop one strategy blueprint per objective and an impact model to measure business effect. Main task and methodology Students explore the topic through research, interviews and real enterprise cases (month 1), classify goals, talent profiles and success patterns (month 2), and build strategy blueprints, a final report and a pitch to Mediacharge leadership (month 3). Recommended methods include desk research, expert interviews, enterprise case analysis, benchmarking and impact modelling. Student requirements Students are fascinated by marketing at international enterprise scale, work analytically and build things that hold up in practice. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. jobs.title: EMEA Marketing Manager
jobs.description: Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day. Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu , founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences. Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta. About the role: We’re looking for a highly strategic and execution-oriented EMEA Marketing Manager to build and scale our regional marketing function, with a strong focus on Spain. Reporting to the VP International Marketing, this individual will be our first dedicated marketing hire in EMEA and will play a critical role in driving pipeline, accelerating deals, and building brand presence across the region — while aligning tightly with Cresta’s global marketing strategy and campaigns. International expansion is a top priority for Cresta: after launching GTM hubs in EMEA and APAC last year, we launched in Spain this year. You’ll partner closely with our regional sales leadership in Spain and gain broad exposure well beyond a single market. Location: London, Remote or based in Spain. jobs.title: Territory Manager (Limestone Coast)
jobs.description: About Halter At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard. We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund , Bessemer Venture Partners , BOND, DCVC , Blackbird , Promus Ventures , Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures . To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram . About the role: As a Territory Manager at Halter, you will play a critical role in driving business growth and ensuring customer success within your designated territory. You will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building strong customer relationships, and meeting ambitious growth targets, all while acting as Halter’s on-the-ground representative. This role requires a proactive and hands-on approach, with a focus on both expansion and long-term customer satisfaction in this role, you will prioritise daily efforts that optimise growth performance and drive value for your customers. jobs.title: Financial Accounting Manager
jobs.description: Not all heroes wear capes — but plenty of them use toilet paper Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion! Funny name, serious business We make eco-friendly products and donate 50% of our profits to provide clean water and help build toilets for the billions of people who lack proper access. So far, we’ve contributed over $18 million AUD (roughly $12.5 million USD) to fund sanitation projects around the globe. Basically, we’re really good at doing good. With hubs in Australia, the Philippines, China, the US, UK and Europe, our amazing team of 200+ work to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next couple of years, we’re hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services. A bit about the role As our Financial Accounting Manager, you’ll be the person who really knows what’s going on inside our UK numbers. You’ll own the monthly close for our UK balance sheet, get across our transaction flows and revenue channels, and work closely with our UK commercial team to keep things on track. You’ll also lead one of our more exciting projects this year: building a proper playbook for how we onboard big new retail customers, so every new partnership starts on the right foot. You’ll have one direct report, and you’ll be part of our senior Financial Operations leadership team — working alongside your Financial Accounting Manager peers in Australia and the US/Canada, and the AR/AP lead, to make sure the numbers tell the right story everywhere we operate. jobs.description: Hi I’m Abhik , Ashby 's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. This role is close to my heart because, as someone who can both design and code, it’s where I’ve always done my best work, but also where I was seen as a rebel and an outsider. I want folks like me to feel at home at Ashby, and so I made Design Engineering a formal role and department that works closely with me. Our first hire was over five years ago, and we’re doubling the team from five to over ten in the next year. This role truly expects you to design and code. Design Engineer at Ashby isn’t just a Frontend Engineer with new branding, nor is it a Designer vibe coding prototypes. Combining excellence in both is where magic happens. I found that when I put my best effort into both the design and technical implementation of a feature, I had a nimbleness and creativity that was hard to achieve when I did only one or the other. For instance, the UX and UI I envisioned often influenced the data model's design and flexibility, while the understanding of technology's capabilities often simplified or improved the design. This role embraces that. You’ll work on our most challenging design problems, help others improve their designs by expanding and enhancing our in-house design system, and consult on bespoke design work needed by Product Engineers. To ground it with examples, Design Engineers at Ashby have: Redesigned our mobile web app by talking with customers who use it often, wireframing new flows, implementing its design system, and using that system to turn the wireframes into a polished UI. Built a set of flexible, composable components in our design system that allow other engineers to build beautiful, consistent setup wizards across our product easily. jobs.description: About Nous Nous is a household AI agent. It takes over the bills and admin people don't have time for and acts for them: switching energy, buying insurance, cancelling forgotten subscriptions, managing the family calendar. Nearly 250,000 UK households have signed up, and another joins every minute. We think the real value of AI isn't writing amazing cover letters, it's doing useful things in the real world for real people. That's the hard part, and a brilliant product is only half of it. An energy switch takes weeks, so our agents run on long-running workflows, not a single chat turn. Cancelling a subscription means a browser agent handling the code Apple sends to your phone. Buying insurance meant getting our regulatory principal comfortable with an agent doing it end to end (a UK first), which comes down to knowing exactly when the LLM should hand over to rules because a mistake would cost someone real money. We're about 30 people running one agent across energy, broadband, mobile, insurance, mortgages and subscriptions (with more being added), each with its own suppliers, rules and ways of going wrong. With far more problems than people, a person or small team owns each one end to end, from spotting it in the data or a customer conversation to shipping the fix. And because the agent acts, you find out quickly whether the fix worked. jobs.title: Senior Partner Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: The Role We are looking for a Senior Partner Deployed Engineer to join the Customer Solutions team, focused on building Coder’s partner ecosystem across EMEA. This is a new function at Coder, modeled on the Forward Deployed Engineer role pioneered by companies like Palantir and now the fastest-growing technical role at frontier AI companies. The difference: instead of embedding with a single customer to deploy a platform, you embed with strategic partners to help them understand, position, and deliver Coder’s platform across their entire customer base. You are part Field CTO, part Industry Strategist, part Technical Specialist, and part Partner Relations Lead. You will be the technical authority within our EMEA partner ecosystem: setting the vision for how Coder fits into each partner’s AI, cloud, and modernization offerings, co-creating the GTM sales plays that partner sellers take to market, building the demonstrations and workshops that generate pipeline, and producing the Partner Relations content that establishes Coder’s technical brand in the ecosystem. This is not a support role. You are equally comfortable holding a strategic roadmap conversation with a partner CTO and debugging a Kubernetes deployment in a partner’s lab in the same afternoon. You are energized by the challenge of building a new category through partnerships, motivated by the multiplied impact of enabling an entire ecosystem rather than a single customer, and capable of operating with full autonomy in a fast-moving startup environment. What You’ll Do Serve as the strategic technical thought partner to EMEA partner leadership, including practice leads, CTOs, and solutions architects at global systems integrators, regional cloud consultancies, and hyperscaler field teams. Own the technical relationship and set the vision for how Coder fits into each partner’s AI and modernization portfolio. jobs.description: Project Engineer Wil jij technische projecten van begin tot eind begeleiden? Krijg jij energie van het organiseren van complexe technische projecten en vind je het leuk om verschillende partijen met elkaar te verbinden? En wil je werken aan innovatieve oplossingen op het gebied van energieopslag en vermogenselektronica? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! Wat ga je doen? Als Project Engineer begeleid je projecten binnen AEP Hybrid Power vanaf de technische overdracht na opdracht tot en met de oplevering. Jij bent de verbindende schakel tussen de klant, engineering, productiepartners, leveranciers en service. Je zorgt ervoor dat technische eisen, planning, budget, documentatie en testen goed op elkaar aansluiten. Je houdt overzicht, signaleert mogelijke problemen op tijd en zorgt ervoor dat acties en afspraken worden opgevolgd. jobs.title: Tender Manager
jobs.description: Do you want to take ownership of how tenders are won, rather than simply contributing to them? Valcon is looking for an experienced Bid Manager to take the lead across the entire bid and tender process. From identifying and qualifying opportunities to defining the strategy, coordinating decision-making, managing stakeholders, safeguarding quality and evaluating results. The primary focus will be on European public tenders. This is explicitly not a traditional bid writing role. Rather than spending your days writing proposals yourself, you ensure that the right people deliver the strongest possible content at the right time. You create structure, challenge subject-matter experts, safeguard the strategy and quality, and keep stakeholders aligned throughout the process. But in case of emergency it is important for you to also be able to write a tender yourself, which occasionally will happen. The principle is simple: don’t write it yourself – enable the team to write it better. What will you do? As Bid Manager, you will be responsible for the end-to-end management of bids and tenders. You will oversee the full tender pipeline and take the lead on complex bid processes involving multiple disciplines, seniority levels and stakeholder interests. De bouwplaats wordt steeds digitaler. Data, IoT, AI, SaaS-oplossingen, sensoren en realtime monitoring bieden mogelijkheden om niet alleen afzonderlijke producten digitaal te ondersteunen, maar de bouwplaats als geheel slimmer, veiliger en efficiënter te maken. Daarbij staat niet één afzonderlijk product centraal, maar de vraag: Hoe ziet de bouwplaats van de toekomst eruit en welke digitale rol kan RECO daarin vervullen? De opdracht moet nadrukkelijk voorkomen dat er alleen een theoretisch adviesrapport ontstaat. jobs.title: Mechanisch monteur
jobs.description: Ben jij die vakkundige monteur die direct zijn weg vindt in de werkplaats? Bij Technison zijn we gespecialiseerd in het leveren van hoogwaardige machines en installaties voor de glastuinbouw. Met jouw passie voor techniek bouw je onze machines in de werkplaats vanaf tekening op en zorg jij ervoor dat elk systeem technisch perfect gemonteerd de deur uit gaat. Taken Als Mechanisch Monteur bij Technison ben jij een onmisbare schakel. Omdat je de nodige vlieguren hebt gemaakt, draai je je hand niet om voor complexe samenstellingen. Je werkt in een hecht team, maar kunt ook uitstekend zelfstandig uit de voeten om alles op rolletjes te laten lopen. Jouw takenpakket is uitdagend en breed: Lassen, zagen en boren van machineonderdelen; Het volledig en nauwkeurig assembleren van onze machines; Testdraaien en technisch controleren of alles perfect functioneert; Het snel en effectief oplossen van storingen; Incidenteel assisteren bij installaties op locatie bij de klant. Heb je ook ervaring met elektra? Dat is een grote pré! We bieden je de ruimte om ook de elektra achter onze machines te verzorgen. Vereisten We zoeken iemand die direct waarde toevoegt aan ons team. Benefits Werken bij Technison betekent werken in een dynamische en creatieve omgeving waar vakmanschap wordt gewaardeerd. jobs.title: Merchant Growth Specialist
jobs.description: Make sure every restaurant on SOUS grows its revenue, across Uber Eats, Just Eat Takeaway and its own direct ordering channel. Full-time About SOUS SOUS exists to give independent restaurants the same acquisition-to-retention infrastructure that only chains and delivery platforms could previously afford. We build it as one connected data layer, replacing the fragmented stack most restaurants run today: a listings tool here, a separate storefront there, and no CRM at all. Spotlight owns discovery, as search shifts from Google links to AI assistants recommending where to eat. Commerce owns the transaction and, critically, the guest relationship that marketplaces have been extracting for a decade. Every order through that owned channel generates data that sharpens the next cycle of visibility, personalisation and retention, compounding in the restaurant's favour instead of the platform's. Our long-term bet is simple. As AI becomes the default interface for "where should I eat", the restaurants that own their guest data and their presence in that layer will keep the margin, and the ones still renting both from marketplaces will not. We are building the infrastructure to make the first outcome the default, not the exception. We are a team of 27, working from our headquarters on the Vijzelstraat in Amsterdam city centre, and we are growing fast across the Netherlands, Germany and South Africa. About the role Our promise to restaurants is simple: SOUS helps you grow. That means more visibility in AI search, more direct orders without commission, and a stronger performance on the delivery platforms restaurants already use. As our merchant base grows quickly, we want every single restaurant to see that growth in its numbers. As Merchant Growth Specialist you make that promise real. jobs.description: Ben jij sterk in plannen, organiseren en het bewaren van overzicht? Krijg jij energie van het coördineren van projecten en zorg jij ervoor dat alles op het juiste moment op de juiste plek is? Dan is deze functie bij OX Power in Barneveld iets voor jou! Taken Als Werkvoorbereider ben jij dé spil tussen verkoop, werkplaats, leveranciers en klanten. Jij zorgt ervoor dat projecten van begin tot eind strak gepland zijn en volgens planning verlopen. Je houdt continu overzicht over de voortgang, signaleert knelpunten voordat ze ontstaan en stuurt bij waar nodig. Een groot deel van jouw functie draait om plannen en coördineren. Je zorgt ervoor dat materialen tijdig aanwezig zijn, de productie efficiënt verloopt en monteurs en collega’s weten wat er wanneer moet gebeuren. Dankzij jouw organisatorische vaardigheden lopen projecten soepel en kunnen deadlines worden gehaald. Tijdens je inwerkperiode maak je ook kennis met onze werkplaats en techniek, zodat je onze producten en processen goed leert begrijpen. jobs.title: Rekrutmen Badan Amil Zakat Nasional (BAZNAS)
jobs.description: Badan Amil Zakat Nasional (BAZNAS) adalah badan resmi dan satu-satunya yang dibentuk oleh pemerintah berdasarkan Keputusan Presiden RI No. 8 Tahun 2001 yang memiliki tugas dan fungsi menghimpun dan menyalurkan zakat, infak, dan sedekah (ZIS) pada tingkat nasional. Berikut ini lowongan kerja Badan Amil Zakat Nasional (BAZNAS). Lahirnya Undang-Undang Nomor 23 Tahun 2011 tentang Pengelolaan Zakat semakin mengukuhkan peran BAZNAS sebagai lembaga yang berwenang melakukan pengelolaan zakat secara nasional. Dalam UU tersebut, BAZNAS dinyatakan sebagai lembaga pemerintah nonstruktural yang bersifat mandiri dan bertanggung jawab kepada Presiden melalui Menteri Agama. Dalam mengelola zakat, BAZNAS menerapkan prinsip 3A, yakni Aman Syari, Aman Regulasi, dan Aman NKRI. Aman Syari artinya pengelolaan zakat yang dilaksanakan BAZNAS harus selaras dengan koridor hukum syari. Pengelolaan zakat harus selaras dan tidak boleh bertentangan dengan sumber hukum Islam, Al-Quran dan Sunnah. jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent

jobs.title: Software Engineer AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent

jobs.description: PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (BNI) Adalah Bank BUMN (Badan Usaha Milik Negara) pertama yang menjadi perusahaan publik setelah mencatatkan sahamnya di Bursa Efek Jakarta dan Bursa Efek Surabaya pada tahun 1996. Berikut ini adalah Rekrutmen Bina BNI Kantor Wilayah 17. P T Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero), Tbk pada awalnya didirikan di Indonesia sebagai Bank sentral dengan nama “Bank Negara Indonesia” berdasarkan Peraturan Pemerintah Pengganti Undang-Undang No. 2 tahun 1946 tanggal 5 Juli 1946. Selanjutnya, berdasarkan Undang-Undang No. 17 tahun 1968, BNI ditetapkan menjadi “Bank Negara Indonesia 1946”, dan statusnya menjadi Bank Umum Milik Negara. Selanjutnya, peran BNI sebagai Bank yang diberi mandat untuk memperbaiki ekonomi rakyat dan berpartisipasi dalam pembangunan nasional dikukuhkan oleh UU No. 17 tahun 1968 tentang Bank Negara Indonesia 1946. Berdasarkan Peraturan Pemerintah No. 19 tahun 1992, tanggal 29 April 1992, telah dilakukan penyesuaian bentuk hukum BNI menjadi Perusahaan Perseroan Terbatas (Persero). Penyesuaian bentuk hukum menjadi Persero, dinyatakan dalam Akta No. 131, tanggal 31 Juli 1992, dibuat di hadapan Muhani Salim, S.H., yang telah diumumkan dalam Berita Negara Republik Indonesia No. 73 tanggal 11 September 1992 Tambahan No. 1A. Lowongan Kerja PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk Saat ini Bank BNI memberikan kesempatan lowongan kerja untuk dapat bergabung bersama dengan posisi sebagai berikut: Bina BNI Kantor Wilayah 09 Job Description: BINA BNI adalah salah satu program BNI untuk membangun bangsa. jobs.description: PT Patra Drilling Contractor (PDC) adalah perusahaan yang bergerak pada bidang jasa penunjang dalam industri energi di Indonesia. Anak Perusahaan PT Pertamina Drilling Services Indonesia (Pertamina Drilling) yang merupakan bagian dari Subholding Upstream Pertamina. Lowongan Kerja PT Patra Drilling Contractor (PDC). PDC (selanjutnya disebut sebagai Perseroan) didirikan pada 11 September 1981 sebagai perusahaan nasional pertama yang fokus menyediakan layanan pengeboran lepas pantai di Indonesia sebagai prioritas pertama. Setelah 38 tahun berkontribusi dalam penyediaan energi nasional, Perseroan semakin memantapkan langkahnya menjadi perusahaan jasa penunjang industri energi terdepan yang mengutamakan keseimbangan antara aspek people dan , profit dan planet. Hal tersebut dibuktikan dengan pertumbuhan kinerja Perseroan secara eksponensial yang diiringi dengan penguatan pada aspek sosial dan lingkungan. Langkah nyata yang dilakukan Perseroan yaitu dengan memperkuat tata kelola keberlanjutan terutama di bidang kesehatan, keselamatan, keamanan dan pelestarian lingkungan serta mendorong pemerataan kesejahteraan sosial di masyarakat sekitar proyek. Laporan Keberlanjutan Tahun 2019 dikembangkan dengan tema: Mengutamakan Keberlanjutan sebagai Cara untuk Terus Bertumbuh. Lowongan Kerja PT Patra Drilling Contractor (PDC) Saat ini PT Patra Drilling Contractor (PDC) memberikan kesempatan lowongan kerja untuk dapat bergabung bersama dengan posisi sebagai berikut: 1. Associate Well Intervention Supervisor Kualifikasi: Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK, diutamakan Sarjana (S1) dari semua jurusan. Memiliki pengalaman sebagai Company Man atau pada posisi yang relevan. Memiliki pengalaman di bidang Workover dan Well Services. Memahami aspek Medium Hazard. Memiliki pengalaman dan kompetensi yang relevan dengan standar APPS PPSDMMigas Cepu. jobs.description: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk adalah salah satu bank milik pemerintah yang terbesar di Indonesia. Bank Rakyat Indonesia (BRI) didirikan di Purwokerto, Jawa Tengah oleh Raden Bei Aria Wirjaatmadja tanggal 16 Desember 1895. Bank BRI memiliki layanan perbankan sampai seluruh penjuru Indonesia dan cukup terkenal oleh masyarakat Indonesia. Berikut ini adalah Rekrutmen Banking Officer Program (BBOP) Terbaru. Berpengalaman lebih dari 120 tahun, Bank BRI senantiasa memberikan kemudahan dan kecepatan dalam merespon berbagai kebutuhan nasabah. Dengan didukung oleh layanan perbankan yang prima, jutaan transaksi nasabah dikelola selama 24 jam sehari 7 hari seminggu melalui fasilitas layanan yang tersebar secara luas di seantero negeri. Dalam menjalankan aktivitas operasional, Bank BRI berpedoman pada visi dan misi yang membantu Perusahaan untuk tetap fokus dalam meraih pencapaian keberhasilan. Visi dan misi ini membantu Bank BRI untuk selalu berupaya mencapai idealisme dengan mengingatkan manajemen serta karyawan bahwa mereka bekerja sama demi tujuan-tujuan yang sama, yang akan menjadi sumbangan dalam keberhasilan jangka panjang Perusahaan. Manage local relationships with administrative/political bodies, and proactively advise on and execute physical partnerships and new business initiatives. 3. Execute land commercialization actions (sales or commercialization of vacant premises), following Asset Manager guidelines. jobs.title: Human Resources Manager
jobs.description: The HR Manager will manage and improve the company’s overall HR operations. This role will help ensure that HR policies, systems, and practices are aligned with business goals, labor laws, and employee needs. The successful candidate will act as a trusted partner to management and employees. They will help build a positive, compliant, and productive workplace while supporting employee growth and organizational development. Duties and Responsibilities Lead the full cycle of HR operations, including recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, compensation and benefits, performance management, training, and employee engagement. Develop, update, and implement HR policies, procedures, and programs that support company goals and comply with Philippine labor laws and DOLE requirements. Manage end-to-end recruitment and talent acquisition strategies to attract qualified candidates through job platforms, LinkedIn, referrals, and other sourcing channels. Improve employee experience by supporting engagement programs, workplace communication, employee feedback, and retention initiatives. Partner with department heads and managers to understand staffing needs, employee concerns, and organizational goals. Guide managers and employees on HR policies, workplace concerns, disciplinary actions, grievance handling, and conflict resolution. Ensure accurate and timely administration of compensation, benefits, government-mandated benefits, employee records, and HR documentation. Monitor HR metrics such as hiring timelines, turnover, attendance, employee engagement, and training needs to support better decision-making. Plan and implement training and development programs to improve employee skills, leadership capability, and work performance. Support performance management processes, including goal setting, performance reviews, coaching, and employee development plans.
